newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BRAZIL DRAW THRILLER WITH ITALY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BRAZIL DRAW THRILLER WITH ITALY.

text.p: World champions Brazil twice trailed Italy by two goals but fought back to draw 3-3 in a thrilling Tournoi de France match on Sunday.
Brazil were losing 3-1 with only 19 minutes to play before goals from Ronaldo and Romario saved them from defeat.

Alessandro Del Piero opened the scoring with a well-taken diving header after only seven minutes and Italy went 2-0 ahead in the 24th when Aldair headed Demetrio Albertini's free-kick into his own net.
Attilio Lombardo then deflected a Roberto Carlos shot into his own net after 35 minutes to make it 2-1.

But Italy regained their two-goal initiative in the 62nd minute when Del Piero scored from a penalty after substitute Filippo Inzaghi was tripped by Aldair just two minutes into his international debut.
Ronaldo pulled the score back to 2-3 after 71 minutes and Romario scored with a superb individual effort six minutes from time to salvage a draw. In between, Roberto Carlos hit the Italian bar.

The result meant that England, who won their opening two matches against Italy and France, will finish top of the standings irrespective of what happens in the last round of games on Tuesday and Wednesday.
